The '''2017–18 Danish Superliga''' season was the 28th season of the [[Denmark|Danish]] [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]], which decides the [[Danish football championship]]. [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] are the defending champions.

==Teams==
[[Esbjerg fB]] finished as loser in the relegation play-offs in the [[2016–17 Danish Superliga|2016–17 season]] and was relegated to the [[2017–18 Danish 1st Division|2017–18 1st Division]] along with [[Viborg FF]] who lost their relegation play-off as well.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2016–17 Danish 1st Division|2016–17 1st Division]] champions [[Hobro IK]] (returned after one year of absence) and 3rd-place finisher [[FC Helsingør]] (returned to the top division for the first time since the [[1936–37 Danish Championship League|1936–37 season]]), who defeated [[Viborg FF]] in the two legged play-off finals.
